title: UG-021 — How to build URL prefill links
intent: Explain the URL patterns used to prefill a survey.
short_answer: Append identifier=value pairs to the survey URL. Use ampersands to join multiple parameters. The URL pattern depends on whether the link is for the test page, published survey, token-secured survey or contact invitation.
important_conditions: For open surveys or surveys secured with password or EU Login, use the published runner link with parameters.
For token-secured surveys, include the token before the query parameters.
For contact invitations, use the invited link pattern with the invitation-specific values.
